description: This file is a shell script for testing various filesystem behaviors using Git commands. It includes tests for case insensitivity, symlink support, Unicode normalization, and filesystem case sensitivity within a Git repository context.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites required for specific tests, such as UTF8_NFD_TO_NFC

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, takes a description and a command

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository for testing
